leadText:
Volume 49 is the 49th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the seventh volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume seven of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Black & White".
plainText:
Volume 49 is the 49th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the seventh volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume seven of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Black & White".

==Blurb==
Black trains hard to prepare to rescue the Gym Leaders from Team Plasma's clutches. Then he tries to convince a group of embittered Pokémon to trust humans again, while Trainer Alder tries to convince Team Plasma's King N that the Pokémon League exemplifies the powerful bond between Pokémon and Trainer. now, will Black be able to enter the Pokémon League and fufill [sic] his dream? And if so...will he win?

Will Black fulfill his dream of winning the Pokémon League...?

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 504 - The Cold Hard Truth
Chapter 505 - A Cold Reception
Chapter 506 - A Week to Go and Old Wounds
Chapter 507 - A Misunderstanding
Chapter 508 - The Lesson Ends Here
Chapter 509 - Will the Truth Come Out?
Chapter 510 - A Wretched Reunion

==Important events==
 
Drayden announces that the 's date has been moved up.
defeats Brycen.
Black goes to Mistralton Cave where he encounters the Swords of Justice.
N challenges Alder to a battle, and is revealed to have tamed .
appears from inside the Light Stone, but reverts back.
N defeats Alder.
tells Gigi that she is free to do what she wants to.
Musha leaves Black.
The third Pokédex meant for is destroyed by N.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
None

===Evolutions===
Black's "Costa" evolves into in PS505.
White's " " evolves into prior to PS508.

==Gym battles==
 defeats the following Gym Leaders:
Brycen in PS505
